description: This file contains functions related to data parallel tensor processing in PyTorch, specifically for managing DTensor parameters in distributed training scenarios. It includes functions for reconstructing, localizing, and transforming DTensors within neural network modules, as well as integration with torch.distributed's DataParallel.

classes.description: This file does not define any classes.

methods.description: Retrieves a submodule and the direct parameter's path within that module based on a dotted path string.

methods.name: _update_module_param(param_list: list[tuple[nn.Module, str, nn.Parameter]])
methods.description: Updates module parameters by replacing existing attributes with new tensors.

methods.name: _reconstruct_dtensor(module: nn.Module, _input: Any)
methods.description: Reconstructs DTensor parameters from local tensors within a module, updating the module's parameters.

methods.name: _localize_dtensor( module: nn.Module, *_: Any, ignored_params: set[nn.Parameter] | None = None )
methods.description: Converts DTensor parameters in a module to local tensors, optionally ignoring specified parameters.

methods.name: _pre_dp_module_transform(module: nn.Module)
methods.description: Prepares a module for distributed data parallel training by transforming DTensors to local tensors and registering hooks for forward passes.
